evidence_spans.quotation: Up to 10 outpatient physiotherapy visits per injury episode are eligible when prescribed by a treating physician.
Prior written authorization is required before the seventh visit. Visits seven through ten without prior written authorization are not payable.

decision_rationale: The schedule version matches the stated coverage period. The physician prescription supports eligibility under Section 5.6, but Section 5.6.1 makes authorization a condition for visits seven through ten. The records indicate that this condition was not met, so the terms support the first six visits but not the full eight-visit request.
condition_assessment: 条件不满足或存在矛盾
source_documents_text: Policy Schedule — Form PT-12, revision 2024-06; coverage period: 1 July 2024 through 30 June 2025. Section 5.6, Physiotherapy benefit: Up to 10 outpatient physiotherapy visits per injury episode are eligible when prescribed by a treating physician. Section 5.6.1: Prior written authorization is required before the seventh visit. Visits seven through ten without prior written authorization are not payable.
claim_requirement_text: Reimbursement is requested for eight outpatient physiotherapy visits for one injury episode. The visits were prescribed by a treating physician, and the claim records list all eight as completed. The records also state that no prior written authorization was obtained before the seventh visit.
missing_or_unmet_conditions: Prior written authorization before the seventh visit; the claim records state that no authorization was obtained.
